metaTitle: Custom Bomber Nursing Scrubs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom bomber nursing scrubs for your team. Bulk pricing, embroidery, and fast turnaround at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Bomber-style nursing scrubs offer a modern, athletic fit that moves with you through long shifts. The ribbed cuffs and hem keep the top securely in place, while the V-neck and zip-front design provide easy layering. For bulk buyers, these scrubs work well with left-chest embroidery or screen-printed logos, giving your healthcare team a sharp, unified look that stands out from traditional V-neck scrub tops.
